review_prompt: Choose the kinds of ServiceNow records to remember on this instance.

types.label: ServiceNow incidents
types.description: Each incident becomes one artifact keyed by its sys_id, however it was opened: the classic form, a workspace record page or a Service Portal or Employee Center ticket page. Records items from whichever ServiceNow account is signed in to this Chrome profile.

types.label: ServiceNow knowledge articles
